ownershipPolicy.description: Each book has one accountable owning repository. Multiple repositories may contribute authoritative domain material. Similar books in different settings, eras, or traditions remain distinct records linked by a shared familyId.
ownershipPolicy.claimMethod: Agent submits a pull request to SURPS development updating the book ownership claim with repository, agent identity, canonical book URL, source path, and evidence. Claims remain pending until reviewed and accepted.
